tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: O que aconteceu ao Rui depois da série?

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Como reagiu a Ana à notícia?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. The blue verb is a verb of change in the infinitive: ficar (a state begins), tornar-se (a lasting change), passar a (a new habit), acabar por (in the end), deixar de (it stops), voltar a (again). Put it in the right form, usually in the pretérito perfeito, and keep the rest of the tile: passar + a trabalhar = passei a trabalhar. With -se the pronoun follows the verb: tornou-se. A tile in brackets, like (eu), says who; it is not written.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: «Fiquei» para um estado, «tornei-me» para uma mudança longa.
